verdict.rationale: Square markets ML-based fraud blocking and mentions 'custom rules and alerts to manage risk' plus a Disputes API to process chargebacks, but there is no documented API, dashboard, or SDK evidence for finance-ops writing custom block/review/allow rules with ML fraud scores exposed—these are only marketing claims, not developer-facing configuration tools. missing for 10: documented fraud-score API/field, rule builder UI or API for block/review/allow actions, independent confirmation of custom rule creation.
